probes.notes: 641-node page (40 sections x grid of 3 cards). Open 964 ms. 10 selections, 1 text edit, 1 style change, 1 drag, 5 undos.

Focus ring visible (2px solid #5fe0cf outline). F6 cycles 7 regions: top-bar, activity-bar, panel-header, canvas-breakpoints, tab-strip, inspector-header, status-bar; never the canvas nor the Layers tree. The Insert palette puts each of its 74 tiles in the Tab order. Opening Layers from the command bar drops the focus to the body. Arrows need an existing selection.
Window 1280x720: canvas region 692x600 = 45% of the window; zoom fits at 48%; no panel clipped.
50 committed font-size changes on a 641-node page; 50 undos restored the original exactly, 50 redos the final state; ~107 ms per step including the driver.

issuesRaw.what: No site-wide colour replace or usage list; a site built with hex values must be recoloured element by element
Command bar property entries are raw English CSS names in the pt-BR UI
Duplicating a page neither opens the copy nor focuses its name (unlike +)
The activity bar icon of the open panel closes the side panel; a person reads it as 'open'
No shared header/footer across pages: duplicated pages carry independent copies; a menu change is repeated per page (unless the person knows to make it a component first)
Insert search 'link' lists 'Bloco de link' (an empty container) before 'Link'
A new element inserted among styled siblings takes none of their look (blue underlined link among muted ones)
Fill from data maps columns by position into slots starting with the image src; a text in src is refused by the validator and the whole fill fails silently (incidents only)
'Enviar arquivos' refuses .csv/.json (only images and fonts), though Fill from data needs a project data file
issuesRaw.evidence: status 'cardapio.csv nao e um arquivo de imagem ou de fonte'

issuesRaw.what: No column-to-field mapping; image values must be project paths (img/x.png)
The Fill action is an unlabelled icon that appears only on hover of the file row
Text typed in an in-place edit that is not yet confirmed is lost on reload, with no leave-page warning (the guard covers only store changes)
issuesRaw.evidence: C5: 'Blend da Casa' kept, ' Especial' lost

issuesRaw.what: Border colour with var(--…) on a class writes the shorthand border-color; the validator refuses the commit (InvalidStateError, incident) and the person sees nothing

The Styles sidebar view does not scroll its own content: the variables list runs under the Layers panel; clicks there close/reopen/float Layers, and the floating Layers window cannot be moved, closed or docked
Variables are not offered anywhere (colour picker, fields): only typing var(--name) works
No 'extract to class' / 'move styles to class': a class starts empty and the element keeps its styles
Command bar finds nothing for 'class'; its backdrop hides the whole editor
Layer names (and so export class names) are fixed in the language of whoever inserted the element
In class mode, sections with only inherited values are collapsed to a summary
Component instances keep generic names (Seção 5…9) with no component badge in Layers/breadcrumb
A floating panel state is persisted with the workspace; the only exit is View › Reset workspace (nothing points to it)
File › Import HTML replaces the whole project (every page) while its confirmation says 'Replace the page with the imported HTML?'; the client's other pages vanish
No way to import an HTML page as a new page of an existing project
Import asks to replace even an empty page, and renames the page and its file after the imported title
Keyboard users cannot reach the canvas or the Layers tree: F6 cycles 7 regions without them, arrows need a selection, Tab walks every palette tile (no roving focus), opening Layers drops the focus
The command bar cannot switch pages or select a layer by name
Exported CSS is ~5x the hand-written equivalent: 39 of 109 rules duplicate another's body; 310 longhand declarations; numbered generated names
Class names come from layer names in the author's language and numbering (secao__titulo-3)
No lang, no button type and links without href reach the export; Checks covers href but not lang or type

issuesRaw.heuristic: H2 match with the real world
issuesRaw.what: Insert search is accent-sensitive and has no synonyms: titulo finds nothing; texto finds only form fields
App opens in English for a pt-BR browser; language only from the status bar
Left rail icons unlabelled; first view is a file Explorer, not the elements
Panel named INSERIR but status/hint call it Elementos
pt-BR copy: Seção colocado (gender); root still Page and page Home untranslated
Two size chips overlap under the selected button (element chip over parent size)
No onboarding: no start screen, templates gallery or first-steps guide
Typing spaces while editing a button's text in place drops them silently (Conhecer os planos -> Conhecerosplanos)

Numeric value inputs with a value, a unit and a reset are squeezed (19 px or invisible): clicks land on the unit button and Enter re-commits the old value with no feedback (font size, column gap, radius, height)
After Enter in an inspector field the focus stays there and Ctrl+Z is a silent no-op
issuesRaw.evidence: messages: no Desfeito until a canvas click

issuesRaw.what: Radius refuses bare numbers (24, 999) that every other length field accepts
Shift+click in Layers adds one row instead of selecting the range
Grid tracks editor shows two '0 trilhas' lists without saying columns/rows; the + moves after the first track
Inspector shows the inherited border as 1.69014px (zoomed canvas) and Borda 'Nenhum' while a base border is visible
The selection label sits over neighbouring content (the card price), causing mis-clicks; the hover size chip covers text
Layers list scrolls/jumps when the selection changes; row positions move under the pointer
The padding link toggle keeps its state across elements
No shorthand entry for spacing (four fields for 14/28)
Templates have no visual preview; no pricing/testimonial/FAQ/footer section templates; Card fits poorly for pricing
Wrap confirmation speaks jargon (envoltório, elemento posicionado)
Messages name one element for a multi-selection (Padding de Cartão: 0px for 3); Sombra summary says nenhum with a shadow; '1 elementos selecionados'
Text combobox fields show two arrows (native datalist + chevron)
Grid tracks editor shows 0 tracks at a breakpoint that inherits 2 from desktop (other fields show the inherited value with its breakpoint badge)
Layers 'Recolher todos os ramos' collapses the page root too: the list goes empty
No way to change a property on all blocks of one kind at once without knowing classes: 24 field edits for side paddings at two breakpoints
Letters typed when focus is not in a field run structure shortcuts until a letter that binds nothing: 'Grãos de café' wrapped an image in a Grade and a Linha and flipped its direction, silently
issuesRaw.evidence: messages after 'Origem de Imagem 2'; document Linha

issuesRaw.what: The file chooser (image source) stays open after a file is chosen; the next click only closes it
Uploaded project fonts are not offered in the Font field's list; the family name must be guessed from the file name
Opening the Font list commits the partially typed text ('Grao') as the font
The Font list menu is clipped on its left edge
An image's placeholder spans the width its real picture will not: the layout changes when the source arrives
Image Source field draws the path over the 'Escolher um arquivo' button text; the button is clipped at the panel's edge
The image chooser lists file names only, no thumbnails
No way to show the client the site: no shareable preview link or hosting; only a ZIP
On a 641-node page the input-to-frame latency p50 is 90 ms (3x the small page) and p95 287 ms
Canvas and Layers tree are unreachable by F6; arrows need a selection; palette has no roving focus (74 tab stops); focus lost after opening a panel from the command bar
At 1280x720 the canvas gets 45% of the window; side panels cannot be narrowed below their defaults without collapsing
